```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot
sns.set(style="ticks")
pairplot = sns.pairplot(data, hue="species", height=1.5, diag_kind="hist", palette="Set2")

# Adjust layout and add title
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Iris Dataset Pairplot by Species", y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
